CustomField.description: Days AI Execution Step records (and their masking records) are kept before the clean-up job deletes them, whatever the conversation's own retention. Steps of a conversation on legal hold are kept. Blank or zero keeps them until their conversation is deleted. Steps are the evidence of what was sent and of Workflow Actions run: set this to match your audit policy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Default 7. Steps are evidence of what was sent and which actions ran; raise this if your audit policy needs longer. Blank keeps them with the conversation.
CustomField.label: Step Retention Days
